plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's mind. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
Talking to this person can feel easy right away. Your minds may move in a similar rhythm. You catch the reference. They get the joke. One of you starts a thought and the other already knows where it is going.

There is relief in this. You do not have to translate yourself as much. You can think out loud without feeling like every sentence needs a disclaimer. Conversation can move quickly because both people are already standing in the same mental room.

When this works, communication becomes one of the easiest parts of the relationship. You can talk for hours. You can move from practical to personal to ridiculous and back again. You can process life together in a way that makes both people feel less alone inside their own heads.

The lesson is discernment. Similar thinking can become a gift, but it can also become an echo chamber. You may agree too quickly. You may skip the same uncomfortable question. You may confirm each other's version of the story because it feels good to be understood.

Do not let ease replace honesty. Use the mental connection to get clearer, not just more comfortable. Ask the question that interrupts the pattern. Tell the truth that sharpens the conversation. The gift here is not agreement. The gift is learning to think clearly together.
